summary: Implemented the S3 Expires customization in botocore (not committed, tests not run per instructions). Changes: (1) botocore/handlers.py adds add_s3_expires_string_member, registered on service-data-loaded.s3. For each S3 operation output with a timestamp Expires member it adds a synthetic ExpiresString string member (header Expires), marks the Expires shape lenientTimestamp, and prepends a deprecation note to Expires documentation. Idempotent. (2) botocore/parsers.py: header timestamps with lenientTimestamp go through _parse_lenient_timestamp_header, which omits the Expires key and logs a warning on parse failure instead of raising; ExpiresString carries the raw value. (3) botocore/model.py: added lenientTimestamp to METADATA_ATTRS. (4) .changes/next-release/feature-S3-expires-string.json changelog entry. Choices: scoped to S3 only; used a shape flag rather than matching the name Expires. Verified by reading only; nothing executed.
